top.title: UAE Property: 'Can my tenant legally list my apartment as a holiday rental without my consent?'
top.teaser: Question: I own an apartment in Dubai Marina, which I've rented to the same tenant for two years. A neighbour recently contacted me because different people appear to be entering the apartment every few days with suitcases. top.impact_reason: Highlights illegal sub-leasing risks for landlords.
top.headline: Tenant sub-leasing Dubai apartment as holiday home without permission
top.summary: A Dubai landlord discovers their tenant is illegally listing the rented marina apartment on holiday home websites. Legal permissions are required for such activities.
top.why: This addresses landlord-tenant regulations and unauthorized property sub-leasing in Dubai.

top.headline: RTA honored for rapid infrastructure project delivery in Dubai
top.summary: Dubai's Roads and Transport Authority received the Dubai-it Award for completing infrastructure projects at record speed. Sheikh Hamdan recognized their achievements.
